scope: Every individual start/stop plus continuous keepalive; darkness is applicable; no occupancy inference or final-state substitution.
threshold_comparison: Strict > for start and < for stop; equality resets the corresponding confirmation timer.
event_time_basis: Confirmation time, not raw rising/falling edge.
keepalive_basis: Accepted active-state messages must cover each confirmed active interval with gaps <=120 s; keepalive outside confirmed active state fails.
waveform_abi: Ordered contiguous [start_s,end_s) piecewise constant external RMS g segments; amplitude is an externally supplied RMS observation, not harvested mechanical energy.
sampling_semantics: Powered periodic RMS observations with declared zero-order hold between consecutive successful samples. Confirmation runs only on successful powered wake/sample; unobserved gaps reset timers.
radio_scope: Ideal atomic A/R storage-side TX impulse and AR digital wire/CRC with O message kinds; not a BLE air link.
